scope: Revalidate the existing 050 opaque media-action ticket flow, complete its specified static evidence artifacts, independently audit it, and add only fail-closed adversarial hardening and offline coverage for 051.

serial_gate.phase_a: P0-CORE-BINDING-USABLE-MEDIA-LOOP-050 must return P0_MEDIA_TICKET_FLOW_READY before phase B starts.
serial_gate.phase_b: P0-MEDIA-TICKET-INDEPENDENT-QUALIFICATION-051 remains offline and must stop before real R3, R4, or R5.

prohibited_actions: Device Auth, Device Pairing, Windows Gateway service, token, OAuth, Runtime, model, Binding, Agent, or Cron changes
real R3, R4, R5, or Analyzer invocation
P0 gate, P0_READY, or PROJECT_STATUS.yaml update
commit, push, tag, deletion of historical evidence, protected-path access, session-archive access, or secret output
frozen_and_preserved: Project Gateway replacement, Device Auth, Pairing, Reply association, card.action.trigger, synthetic commands, inbound_claim, and native slash registration: DEFERRED_TO_P1_CHANNEL_HARDENING
acceptance: 050 is revalidated entirely offline with real R0-R2 baseline and R3-R5 status kept accurately unqualified
the ticket route rejects Unicode or rewritten commands and all adversarial invalid states before Analyzer dispatch
ticket state is hash-only, ignored by Git, atomically written, and recovers stale consuming state fail-closed
all requested 051 reports distinguish static, synthetic, and real evidence and provide a user-controlled R3-R5 runbook
no prohibited live, configuration, status, or Git action occurs
rollback: Only scoped offline source, test, ignore, task-plan, and report changes may occur. Reverting those files restores the prior offline 050 state; no runtime or production change exists to roll back.
secrets: Do not read, emit, persist, or scan protected credential stores. All reports use only safe status/count/hash-presence facts.
